0.original: Linette wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Miners' Guild.

1.original: You have been referred to Adalberta, the master of the Miners' Guild. Meet her at the bar.

2.original: Adalberta warmly welcomes you to the guild, and presents you with your very own─very <hex:021A020203>old<hex:021A020103>─pickaxe. Take up the tool of your new trade, and speak with the guildmaster again to be issued your first task.

24.original: Speak with Adalberta, the master of the Miners' Guild.

48.original: So, are you ready to join the Miners' Guild?

49.original: Oh. Are you quite certain? I felt sure that you were destined to make the next big find... I pictured you grinning next to a lump of gold the size of your head.

50.original: 'Tis truly a shame, but if you still have your doubts, there is no help for it. Should you be struck by a sudden desire to amass untold wealth, I shall be here to help.

51.original: Music to my ears! Aye, the kind made when one's pickaxe strikes gold!

52.original: You must introduce yourself to Guildmaster Adalberta right away.

53.original: Her approval is required if you are to be formally admitted to our ranks.

54.original: In case you're unaware, Adalberta is perhaps the most accomplished of those miners who still swing a pickaxe.

55.original: Her understanding of our trade is unsurpassed, and her flair for prospecting uncanny. Her brain, in short, is a veritable <hex:021A020203>gold mine<hex:021A020103> of knowledge─much of it concerning the mining of gold.<hex:02100103>...Ha ha! Jesting apart, you stand to learn a great deal from her.

56.original: When you are ready, pray present yourself to Adalberta. You will find her down the steps yonder, over by the bar.

57.original: Well met, adventurer. Adalberta's my name, and I'm the master of this guild.

58.original: I take it you wish to become a miner. Well, our doors are open to all who aren't afraid to work hard and get dirty.

59.original: Thanks to recent advances in refining techniques, it's now possible to smelt even low-purity ores. I mention this because it's allowed us to reopen a number of mines which were long thought exhausted, prompting trade to flourish.

60.original: Truth be told, with business as it is at the moment, we can't take on enough new miners. And few folk make better miners than adventurers, you being a hardy lot.

61.original: What's more, you're well traveled, which serves to expand the guild's sphere of activity. Oh, but I'm not suggesting you join solely for <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> benefit.

62.original: For your part, you'll acquire skills that will prove to your profit─a mutually beneficial arrangement, I trust you'll agree. So what say you? You will join us, yes?

63.original: Ready to work hard and get dirty?

66.original: This is...unexpected. You have so much to gain and nothing to lose. Won't you reconsider?

67.original: Then I bid you welcome to the Miners' Guild! May your toils never go unrewarded!

68.original: Now then, here's a pickaxe to get you started. It's not the newest, but it should serve a novice well enough.

69.original: Go on and take it up─see how it feels in your hands.

70.original: Speak to me again when you're ready, and I'll assign you a little task to help you get into the swing of things.

71.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the tool received from this quest.

72.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

73.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
